question: Has Avopro been acquired by or merged with another company? Who owns Avopro now?
markdown:
Assuming you mean
AVPro Global Holdings
(the prominent audio/video distribution and control conglomerate parent of AVPro Edge, Murideo, and AudioControl Pro), the company has been an active acquirer rather than an acquired target. However, if you are referring to a different entity like
Avopro EPZ
(an avocado oil producer in Kenya) or
AOVOpro
(electric scooters), their ownership remains independent or distinct.
AVPro Global
Below is the status for the primary audiovisual industry interpretation:
AVPro Global Acquisitions & Ownership
Recent Acquisitions:
Acquired
Remote Technologies Incorporated (RTI)
(intelligent home/business automation and control) in May 2025.
Acquired
ThenAudio
(audio/video connectivity solutions) in November 2023.
Acquired the
AudioControl Home Division
in August 2023.
AVNetwork
Current Ownership:
AVPro Global Holdings LLC remains a privately held American company headquartered in Sioux Falls, South Dakota. It continues to be led and was founded by its chief executive officer,
Jeff Murray

Avopro
